description: User profile page allowing GET and POST requests. GET returns profile form, POST updates user information (name, lastname, email, loan_amount, loan_term_months, monthly_payment). Returns 302 redirect if not authenticated.

details.status: 302 (redirect if not authenticated), 200 (GET if authenticated), 302 (POST redirect if authenticated)

notes: Vulnerable to: CSRF attacks (no token validation), mass assignment attacks (directly maps form fields to user object), authorization bypass (only checks session existence), data type attacks (loan_amount, loan_term_months parsed without validation).
